sources: Per-club impact-model inputs (#15443). pipeline_default_clubs keep the SwingBallFlightPipeline defaults (head 0.200 kg, scalar moi 5e-3 kg m^2, driver COR) so the driver path is numerically unchanged. Other catalogue clubs take the head mass from club_models and scale reference_head_moi_kg_m2 by the catalogue head m*k^2 ratio to the reference club, with k^2 the mean of the squared gyration radii about the two axes perpendicular to the face normal (the axes a face-offset torque turns the head about); an approximation from catalogue geometry, not a measured inertia. cor_by_club: USGA/R&A limit 0.830 applies to driver faces (CT test, Rules of Golf Appendix II). No source for a lower iron COR was found (a web search for a measured 7-iron value returned none), so iron7 keeps 0.830 and is flagged as an open question rather than an invented number.
rigid_gear_sources: Head inertia for the rigid-contact gear law (physics/impact_model/rigid_gear.py), principal values about the head CG along the face normal, heel and face-up axes, and the CG depth behind the face. These are the research assumptions of the phase-two matched-delivery study (src/tools/shot_pattern_analysis/matched_config.py: driver preset and seven_iron preset), not measured properties of a specific head. A club without an entry uses rigid_gear_default_club, as club_impact_for launches an unknown club with the driver defaults.
